title: Bongard Problems
summary: The article discusses Bongard Problems, a set of visual puzzles that challenge pattern recognition and abstract reasoning, and explores their relevance to AI and cognitive science.
highlights: Bongard Problems are a class of visual puzzles that require identifying a rule distinguishing two sets of images.
They are used to study human and machine pattern recognition and abstract reasoning.
The article likely examines how these problems relate to AI challenges and cognitive models.
